post.description: Local businesses matching a category or a business name near a street address, city/state or postal code (US and other Bing Maps markets). One page of up to 30 results with Bing ypid, name, street address, phone, website, coordinates, category, aggregate rating with review count and source (Yelp/Tripadvisor/...), and current open status (Open/Closed in the business's local time, with Bing's rendered sentence such as "Open · Closes 10 PM"). Results are not filtered by opening hours: to find what is open now, read `open_status` on the rows. Use the ypid with `business` for structured weekly hours.

count.description:
Results per page.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 30; default 18.

latitude.description:
Optional map centre latitude; provide together with longitude to bias results when no location text is given.

Provider reference: minimum -90; maximum 90.

location.description: Where to look: a street address ("1600 Pennsylvania Ave NW, Washington, DC"), "City, ST" or a postal code. Sent to Bing as "<query> near <location>". Optional when query already names the place.

longitude.description:
Optional map centre longitude; provide together with latitude.

Provider reference: minimum -180; maximum 180.

page.description:
Result page; page N returns the businesses among Bing's top N*count that are not among its top (N-1)*count, so consecutive pages do not repeat businesses. next_page is null once a page adds no business beyond the earlier pages (Bing caps one response at about 50).

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 5; default 1.

query.description: What to find: a category such as "restaurants", "pharmacies", "plumbers", or a business name such as "Franklin Barbecue".

200.description:
Local businesses matching a category or a business name near a street address, city/state or postal code (US and other Bing Maps markets). One page of up to 30 results with Bing ypid, name, street address, phone, website, coordinates, category, aggregate rating with review count and source (Yelp/Tripadvisor/...), and current open status (Open/Closed in the business's local time, with Bing's rendered sentence such as "Open · Closes 10 PM"). Results are not filtered by opening hours: to find what is open now, read `open_status` on the rows. Use the ypid with `business` for structured weekly hours.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `results` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `address` | string | Single-line street address as Bing prints it. |
| `category` | string |  |
| `category_path` | string |  |
| `image_url` | string |  |
| `latitude` | number |  |
| `longitude` | number |  |
| `maps_url` | string |  |
| `name` | string |  |
| `open_hours_text` | string | Bing's rendered status sentence, e.g. "Open · Closes 10 PM", "Closed · Opens tomorrow 7 AM", "Closes in 24 mins" or "Open 24 hours". |
| `open_status` | string | "Open" or "Closed" at the time of the call in the business's own time, as Bing renders it in the result row; null when Bing shows no hours for the business. |
| `phone` | string | Display phone, e.g. "(202) 638-2570". |
| `rating` | number | Rating exactly as Bing reports it; scale depends on rating_source (for example Yelp versus ZocDoc). |
| `rating_count` | number |  |
| `rating_source` | string | Yelp, Tripadvisor, Foursquare, ... as shown by Bing. |
| `style_category` | string |  |
| `website` | string |  |
| `ypid` | string |  |
